start_here: Say to your AI: "List the services my account is connected to and which of them can send right now." It runs tool:list-connections and hands back one row per connection with its status and can_send.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it works from the connection records you hand it and the names the vault holds, and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Connect at least one service first (for example Stripe through tool:connect-an-account-by-signing-in-to-the-service, or a key kept in the vault).

2. Say "List my connections"; your AI reads your connection records (type connection) from your store, reads the names of the connections your vault holds, and runs tool:list-connections with {"connection_records": [{id, value}, ...], "held_connections": [{connection_id, fields}, ...]}.
3. Read each row: connection_id, service, vendor, status, can_send and connected_at; a connection the vault holds with no record yet shows only its id, service and vendor.
4. A row with can_send false or status disconnected needs connecting again before anything is sent through it.
